propositions: A project-only criterion (project.symbol-reference-completeness) must route to plan_review only, not code_review, because code-review applies_when tags are drawn from a closed vocabulary that excludes project.* criterion ids, making such moves permanently dead.

When a plan's affected-file or call-site inventory was enumerated by hand or is demonstrably incomplete, the criterion should detect this and coach re-derivation with Serena's symbol tools plus string-literal sweep (monkeypatch.setattr/getattr/importlib) that LSP cannot resolve.
The criterion must have advisory posture via default_posture: advisory with no inert blocking_enabled key, since it coaches method not correctness, and blocking would gate process noisily.
Code-review coaching moves were already overlay-driven via code_review/moves.py::load_move_registry reading .rebar/code_review_moves.json, so no engine wiring changes are required.

Detection is deterministically demonstrated on real hand-enumerated plans at validity 1.0 naming omitted files; coaching move applicability is proven in tests, though LLM selection is not overlay-controllable and cannot guarantee the move appears in any single run output.
